name: FSN E-Commerce Ventures Ltd. (Nykaa)
business_summary: Omnichannel beauty, personal-care and fashion retailer (Nykaa, Nykaa Fashion, Nykaa Man, owned brands such as Kay Beauty and Dot & Key; Superstore and distribution arms). TTM sales Rs 11,309 cr (+28%), EBITDA Rs 951 cr (8.4%), profit Rs 327 cr. Sep-26 quarter: sales Rs 3,006 cr (+28%), EBITDA Rs 263 cr (8.7%), PAT Rs 101 cr (about 3x y/y); fashion turned profitable; board approved acquiring 82% of Simply Nam (premium makeup) on 2026-11-04. Stock Rs 347, +38% in 12m, P/E ~300 and 60x book: priced for years of margin expansion. Promoters 52.07%, FIIs rose to 15.65%.

exposures.mechanism: Discretionary urban beauty/fashion, beta ~1.2: +5pp urban growth -> +6pp GMV/revenue; contribution margin ~28% on TTM sales Rs 11,309 cr => +Rs 190 cr = 20% of EBITDA Rs 951 cr; EV/MCap 1.0; persistence 0.3 (cyclical) => +6.

evidence.note: Q2 FY27 results per Economic Times 2026-11-04 and screener pack

exposures.mechanism: Beauty premiumisation (higher AOV, imported and prestige brands) is the structural leg of the thesis; judgemental +2 per unit with low confidence.
